tips.text: If the quest stays on the build step after you claim the Odonata, open the Quests menu, select The Archwing and press Begin.
Launch each quest step from the orbiter or the quest alert, not by walking through a gate.
Scan high-level targets with an invisible frame like Ash, Loki, Ivara or Octavia to earn Simaris Standing fastest.
Nobody complains about the weapon itself; the grumbles are the quest bugging on the build step and Neurodes.
